name: Farm tractor

comps.spec: Gear pump, control valves and lift cylinders for the three-point hitch and loader
comps.loc: Rear hitch, loader arms and under the seat

comps.spec: High-pressure hydraulic hoses with quick couplers
Shared hydraulic and transmission fluid, 30–150 L, plus engine oil
Diesel in the tank, 40–300 L; diesel keeps far longer than petrol
comps.loc: Tank beside or under the cab

comps.spec: Rear PTO shaft, 540 or 1,000 rpm — drives a PTO generator, pump or saw

comps.loc: Under the hood or a side step

comps.spec: GPS receiver and guidance display (newer large tractors)
comps.loc: Dome on the cab roof; display in the cab

notes: A running diesel tractor is a power plant: the PTO turns generators and pumps. Lower implements to the ground before working on hydraulics.
